   heading without an explicit line-height inherits it. This floor keeps that
   from happening; the per-section rules below override it. */

<!-- ===== SECTION 02 — COMPANY STORY ===== -->
<section class="ab-story band-white" id="story" data-screen-label="Company Story">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="ab-story-grid">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">WHO WE ARE</span>
        <h2>We built Kleza because small businesses deserved the same AI advantage as the <span class="ital">enterprises that could afford it.</span></h2>
        <p>Kleza didn't start out chasing trends. It started with a problem we kept seeing everywhere, small and mid-sized businesses wanted the same quality and results that big enterprises could afford, but never had access to the same tools or budgets. So we set out to close that gap, and we're still closing it today, one client at a time. </p>
        <p>For years, our growth had nothing to do with any single technology, it came from doing good work and earning trust the hard way. Then, as the tools available to businesses started changing, we didn't rush in just to keep up. We took the time to learn it properly, and built it into how we already worked, so it strengthened our team instead of replacing it.</p>
        <p>Along the way, healthcare became where we proved ourselves the most. It's an industry with no room for mistakes, and working with home care agencies, hospitals, pharmacies, and health-tech companies across the USA taught us exactly what "getting it right" means, and what it costs to get it wrong. Those same standards now go into everything we build, for every business we work with. 

Today, that promise is carried forward by a team of more than 60 people in Hyderabad, India, who bring the same care, precision, and honest effort to every single project. 

We're Kleza Solutions. What you get from us is simple: solid engineering, smart technology, and people who are genuinely invested in getting it right for you, every time.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="ab-pullquote">
        <span class="mk">&ldquo;</span>
        <p>With Kleza, you're not keeping up with the future. You're building it.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ab-facts">
      <div class="ab-fact"><div class="n">2020</div><div class="l">Founded</div></div>
      <div class="ab-fact"><div class="n">USA + India</div><div class="l">Locations</div></div>
      <div class="ab-fact"><div class="n">60+</div><div class="l">Team members</div></div>
